description: Change a label, inbound/outbound availability, retention preference or voice system using the number revision. voice_system is cascade (default: speech-to-text, a language model, then a voice from the full catalog) or full_duplex (GPT Live, which listens while it speaks, with Patch's custom voices; see list_voices); it applies to the number's inbound and outbound calls and tests from the next one, without republishing. Enabling an unpublished direction activates its initial defaults; saved drafts and existing live settings are preserved.
name: update_phone_number
